blocks.html: Talk to Commander Denulth in Burthorpe, east of the castle.
blocks.text: Talk to Commander Denulth in Burthorpe, east of the castle.

options.text: How goes your fight with the trolls?
Is there anything I can do to help?

substeps.html: If Denulth tells you that the ambush is still being planned, try asking him about the White Knights first.
substeps.text: If Denulth tells you that the ambush is still being planned, try asking him about the White Knights first.

options.text: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia.

blocks.html: If you don't own climbing boots, buy them from Freda
blocks.text: If you don't own climbing boots, buy them from Freda

options.text: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

blocks.html: Enter Sabbot's cave from Death Plateau and cross all the obstacles to reach the exit of the tunnel (recommended for low Defence and Constitution levels).
blocks.text: Enter Sabbot's cave from Death Plateau and cross all the obstacles to reach the exit of the tunnel (recommended for low Defence and Constitution levels).

substeps.html: Alternatively, take the shortcut by running through the Death Plateau on the surface, clockwise around it, and climbing the rocks to the northwest, then climb the cliffside while wearing climbing boots. Beware of level 67 thrower trolls - Protect from Ranged, Dive, and Fremennik round shield are advised when taking this route.
substeps.text: Alternatively, take the shortcut by running through the Death Plateau on the surface, clockwise around it, and climbing the rocks to the northwest, then climb the cliffside while wearing climbing boots. blocks.html: Exit the cavern, climb the rocks to the immediate west of the exit and follow the path east over the rocks until you reach the arena entrance.
blocks.text: Exit the cavern, climb the rocks to the immediate west of the exit and follow the path east over the rocks until you reach the arena entrance.

blocks.html: Open the arena entrance and attempt to leave through the northern entrance.
blocks.text: Open the arena entrance and attempt to leave through the northern entrance.

blocks.html: Defeat Dad after he attempts to attack you. You may choose to kill him or spare him after defeating him.
blocks.text: Defeat Dad after he attempts to attack you. You may choose to kill him or spare him after defeating him.

substeps.html: An easy way to kill Dad safely is to bring him over to the northern entrance or down by the southern rocks and safespot him.

blocks.html: Follow the path north-west, go through the cave to the north and go outside.
blocks.text: Follow the path north-west, go through the cave to the north and go outside.

blocks.html: Once outside, continue the path to the stronghold to the north and west; thrower trolls can be dealt with by:

substeps.html: Taking agility shortcuts around them with level 47 Agility. The cliffside shortcut may be used to avoid the thrower trolls completely.
substeps.text: Taking agility shortcuts around them with level 47 Agility. The cliffside shortcut may be used to avoid the thrower trolls completely.

substeps.html: Running counter-clockwise around the mountain, past the thrower trolls (not behind them: they are supposed to throw rocks at you automatically) to the west.
substeps.text: Running counter-clockwise around the mountain, past the thrower trolls (not behind them: they are supposed to throw rocks at you automatically) to the west.

substeps.html: Protect from Ranged against them.
Use Dive to quickly run past them.

substeps.html: Equip Fremennik round shield to reduce their damage greatly.
substeps.text: Equip Fremennik round shield to reduce their damage greatly.
